Class GroupErrorRoutes

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.GroupErrorRoutes
@Internal public final class GroupErrorRoutes extends Object
The error and status routes declared in the groups of handler routes, see HttpRouteGroup: local to the routes of the group, like the non-global @Error methods of a controller are local to its routes. The error route of a request is looked up in the innermost group of its route first, then in the groups around it, and for a route resolved by a DynamicRouteTarget, then in the error scopes of the resolution. Within a group, the error route of the closest exception type answers. The server looks the local error routes of the declaring type up before, and the global error routes after them.
Since:
5.3.0
